description: This bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the popularity of three distinct knowledge domains—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—across three different model configurations, represented by color-coded and patterned bars. The vertical axis, labeled "Popularity," is scaled linearly from 20 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20, and measures the relative popularity of each knowledge category for each model setup. The horizontal axis categorizes the knowledge domains: "Movies," "Songs," and "Basketball," presented in that order from left to right. The legend identifies six distinct model configurations: Llama3 (solid blue), Qwen2 (solid red), ChatGPT (solid yellow), Acc=0 & GT Ans (hatched blue), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (hatched red), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (hatched yellow). For each domain, there are six corresponding bars, each with a unique color and pattern combination. In the "Movies" category, the bars are relatively short, with Llama3 (blue) at approximately 40, Qwen2 (red) at approximately 35, ChatGPT (yellow) at approximately 30, Acc=0 & GT Ans (hatched blue) at approximately 25, Acc=0 & Gene Ans (hatched red) at approximately 20, and Acc=1 & GT Ans (hatched yellow) at approximately 15. In the "Songs" category, the bars are taller, with Llama3 (blue) at approximately 70, Qwen2 (red) at approximately 65, ChatGPT (yellow) at approximately 55, Acc=0 & GT Ans (hatched blue) at approximately 50, Acc=0 & Gene Ans (hatched red) at approximately 45, and Acc=1 & GT Ans (hatched yellow) at approximately 40. In the "Basketball" category, the bars are significantly taller, with Llama3 (blue) at approximately 170, Qwen2 (red) at approximately 180, ChatGPT (yellow) at approximately 100, Acc=0 & GT Ans (hatched blue) at approximately 100, Acc=0 & Gene Ans (hatched red) at approximately 100, and Acc=1 & GT Ans (hatched yellow) at approximately 100. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the knowledge domains along the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern differentiation.
